source_law: all 1722 ordered nonidentity distinct-point pairs on E(F47): y^2=x^3-x-2 of order 43, with the frozen integer point lifts
post_run_feasibility_filter: enumerate all pairs with P+6Q=O at F47; among those, retain candidates with equal lifted x coordinates modulo 11, necessary if P+6Q=O on a group of order 5 at 11; retain all 1722 source statuses
coefficient_box: for each surviving pair, k1,k2,k3 in {-2,-1,0,1,2} in lexicographic order; set a1,a2,a3=47*k_i and solve the two rational point equations for a4,a6
local_gate: at 7 require good reduction, #E(F7)=4 and P+6Q=O; at 11 require good reduction, #E(F11)=5 and P+6Q=O; retain nonintegral, bad-reduction, order-mismatch and relation-mismatch statuses
rational_check: on every nonsingular constructed curve, calculate P+6Q over Q and retain its exact truth value
resource: 1722 finite-field source checks and at most 250 rational curve constructions; no wall-time comparison
claim_boundary: post-run reduced-compatible feasibility screen, not an input-independent unknown-target selector; no rank or one-target speedup inference
